title: The 2 Best Noise Cancelling Headphones for Office 2026
h1: The 2 Best Noise Cancelling Headphones for Office 2026
metaDescription: Our 2 picks for noise cancelling headphones for office 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at noise cancelling headphones for office 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Sony WH-1000XM5
strengths: Multipoint Bluetooth connects to laptop and phone simultaneously
Speak-to-chat pauses music when you start talking
30-hour battery covers multi-day office use between charges
limitations: Call microphone quality slightly behind Jabra and Poly dedicated UC headsets

products.name: Apple AirPods Max
strengths: Best ANC and transparency mode for Apple ecosystem users
Seamless switching between iPhone and Mac
limitations: Heavy, noticeable neck strain after 6+ hours

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
